Principles of the peaceful day

The aim of this section is to explain the plain rules for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

The desk accepts companion animal travel records in a steady, respectful manner and keeps the welfare of the animal first in every step. Staff must review the booking file, the travel papers, and the comfort needs of the animal before any acceptance is confirmed. A welfare coordinator reviews the animal condition and notes any care limits in the desk ledger. The welcome team must prepare the passenger for boarding with clear guidance, calm handling, and prompt record keeping.

All documents must be complete before travel is approved. The desk records any service change at once, and staff must not rely on memory when the ledger is available. If the traveler presents a cat file, <<FACT F079>> and the record must show that the document was checked before release. If the traveler presents a bird file, <<FACT F077>> and the desk must note the review in plain language. Staff must not add stray remarks, and they must keep the language factual, brief, and orderly.

The desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone, but it does not bend the rules for convenience. Where an animal shows signs of stress, staff must pause the process and seek the welfare coordinator at once. Records must remain clear, current, and legible, and any correction must be entered in the ledger without delay.

For guidance or escalation, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
